title: Counting rules and word lists
description:
Purpose: deterministic counting of gratitude and F-bomb tokens over extracted human messages.

Scope: versioned word lists (gratitude and F-bomb families) in a YAML config with a loader; matching engine with word boundaries, case-insensitivity, unicode normalization, and a path/URL guard; exclusion strippers for fenced and indented code blocks, quoted text, and pasted regions (thresholds configurable); occurrence and message-level counting.

Done when: counting is a pure deterministic function of (messages, word list config); the same input always yields the same counts; matches inside code blocks, quotes, pastes, and file paths never count; unit tests cover boundary cases (word boundaries, caps, normalization) and pass.
